<!-- Project: Bunny Care – Your Safe Place in Tokyo -->
<!-- Stack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Supabase -->
- Use pastel pink/white/yellow color scheme defined in tailwind.config.js
- Mobile-first design, max-w-md centered layout
- All UI text in Vietnamese
- Use 'card-cute' CSS class for card components
- Supabase client is in src/lib/supabase.ts
- Shared data/constants in src/lib/data.ts
- App Router with pages in src/app/
